name: Keynote
reference: Apple keynote and product films in black: one product, one line, a light sweep across the surface.
pattern: Near-black ground, white type, grey secondary type, one system blue kept for a link or a selected state. The product supplies all other colour.
personality: Theatre. A single subject emerges from black and is lit, slowly.

motion.character: Slow push-ins, a light sweep across the subject, masked type reveals.
motion.transitions: Fade through black, or a cut on the beat.

texture.note: A thin rim light on the subject's edge. Never a glow or a coloured cloud behind it.

grammar: The ground stays flat black: no gradient, no glow.
One line of type per scene.
needs: A product render or photograph for the subject.

pictures.note: One product photograph emerges from black, lit; the push is slow.

footage.note: Slow product b-roll on black: a turn, a light passing.

music.feel: cinematic ambient swell, piano and strings, hopeful

hits.note: A swell into the reveal; one low impact on the product's name.

hook.how: The subject lit on black on frame 0, a slow push running, with the bed audible. Never 2 s of near-black.

compose.how: The line first, at the text-safe top (its height from lineH); then the product under it, framed with `room`: the frame under the line, a body line height below it. The product's drawn bounds at their largest over the shot then stay clear of the line by construction: never on the handle or the rim. The anchor `<product id>-object-extent` holds those bounds, to check the gap.

moves.move: A light sweep: a narrow band of light crosses the subject's surface once, at its brightest on an accent.

measurable.how: A bright band moves across the subject's mask over 30-50 frames.

moves.move: A thin rim light draws the subject's dark edge.
Slow push-ins of 15-20 % on long holds; a shot never stops.

measurable.how: No stretch longer than maxStill without change.

moves.move: One line of type per scene, revealed through a mask.

blocks.for: A 3D subject with its sweep and rim.

props.sweep: a light band on the accent time, masked by the cut-out
props.rim: a rim line from the cut-out

blocks.for: A photographed subject, with its sweep and rim.

props.maxLines: 2 (with 1, a sentence steps down to body size and warns)

blocks.for: One sentence per scene, in display or headline.
A swell into the reveal, one low impact on the name.
The held finish: the name and one line, landing on a beat.

avoid.why: Keynote is slow; one line per scene.
A keynote states one number, not a chart.

ends.how: The subject small and centred, the full name in headline under it, with the one low impact on the card.
ends.with: `name`, `line`, `at` on the last strong beat, with the one low impact

mix.note: A cinematic swell; the bed is audible from frame 0 and rises into the reveal.

shots.match: One subject in one light, from different angles: front, side, detail. Never one picture turned.

subjectsToAvoid: Fibonacci numbers or the golden spiral
FizzBuzz or a sort of ten numbers
a phone with a generic glowing screen
